shared_elements: tall rectangular stone slab of pale tan limestone
horizontal band/line demarcating a zone near the top
row of short parallel vertical strokes forming a linear register
incised (as opposed to painted) marks on a rough stone surface
justification: Both are upright tan stone slabs whose decoration is organised by a horizontal line near the top, and each contains a register of short repeated parallel strokes, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A carries only thin, shallow abstract linear signs arranged along the margins of an otherwise blank field, while B is dominated by bold, rounded high-relief figurative imagery (birds, quadrupeds, discs) covering the whole surface of a shaped T-form monument.
